patthana18.20:1.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: ekaṃ.
patthana18.20:2.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo na hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: tīṇi. hetuyā cattāri.
patthana18.20:3.1: āsavavippayuttaṃ sāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na anāsavo na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā: āsavavippayuttaṃ anāsavaṃ nahetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca āsavavippayutto na sāsavo na nahetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā dve. chagocchaka dukahetuduke chagocchakaduka nahetudukaṃ
